primary_result: The fully controlled two-fold set-wise mechanism screen fails the frozen futility contract. Primary policy gain is +0.000192 dB point with UCB95 +0.000707 dB, oracle retention is 0.001275 point with UCB95 0.004825, true-minus-action-value-shuffle UCB95 is +0.001876 dB, and set-wise-minus-independent UCB95 is +0.000360 dB. The primary policy selects no negative actions and has only 4.95% worse-operator coverage. In contrast, grouped severe risk is genuinely identifiable: severe AUROC is 0.850951 with LCB95 0.815020, AUPRC is 0.645505 at prevalence 0.235677, and AUPRC-minus-risk-label-shuffle LCB95 is +0.152328.
gate_reasons: Gain UCB95 +0.000707 dB fails to reach the +0.020 dB A1 non-futility target.
True-minus-action-value-shuffle UCB95 +0.001876 dB fails to reach +0.005 dB.
Set-wise-minus-independent UCB95 +0.000360 dB and utility-risk-minus-mean-only UCB95 +0.000707 dB fail their +0.005 dB mechanism targets.
Primary-minus-best-nuisance UCB95 +0.000452 dB fails +0.005 dB; the primary point estimate is worse than the best nuisance control.
Risk discrimination gates pass strongly: severe AUROC LCB95 0.815020, AUPRC lift LCB95 +0.339207, and AUPRC-minus-risk-label-shuffle LCB95 +0.152328.
Selected severe/hard group counts are both zero, but observed primary coverage is only 4.95% and the 10% descriptive risk-coverage point has an exact severe UCB95 of 7.39%.
The runtime permutation audit reaches 1.907e-6 against the frozen 1e-6 numerical tolerance; this formal miss is tiny and is not the cause of the much larger utility futility.
competing_explanation: The evidence rejects rare-risk unidentifiability as the main remaining explanation: candidate severe risk is learnable and survives the risk-label-shuffle control. The favored explanation is that the frozen state/action/RGB/first-encoder representation does not support material relative signed utility or safe action execution. Cross-candidate attention does not add value over the matched independent scorer and the policy remains positive-only and highly abstaining.
limitations: A1 is a preregistered two-fold development futility screen, not the full four-fold A2 estimate; its valid FAIL prevents A2 rather than estimating final performance.

The conclusion applies to the frozen three-action bank, fixed set architecture, four inference-visible feature families, two-member ensemble, loss and calibration rule; it does not test a materially new inference-time representation.
The permutation tolerance miss is consistent with floating-point accumulation order, but the frozen gate is still formally failed and was not changed after the result.
Confirmation, historical A1X-432 outcomes, canary and locked test were not accessed.
